title: User identity fields (name, avatar, colour) are seeded once and never re-synced, leaving stale values across surfaces
reason: Discussion initially debates whether auth-provider or Zero synchronization owns identity updates, then the author says the finding was overstated: values are internally consistent, so the issue is closed as not an actual bug.

varveAssessment.assessment: The reporter withdraws the defect claim after rechecking upstream behavior; no Varve issue is established.

title: Make the draw tool's auto-close behavior configurable (sensitivity and on/off)
reason: The original client asks for sensitivity/on-off controls, but the follow-up says auto-close need not change; instead, a connecting line should be drawn when auto-closing. The narrowed requested outcome is visual feedback, not configurability.

varveAssessment.assessment: The clarified stroke feedback request requires a local drawing UX comparison; no implementation was inferred from the initial ask.

title: Ignore pinch-to-zoom while a tool is in an active interaction state
reason: Reports second-touch pinch gestures interrupting or corrupting an active touch drawing/tool interaction. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Concrete touch/canvas regression lead; Varve's active-tool pinch arbitration was not inspected or device-tested here.

title: Long toast content is not truncated and overflows
reason: Reports long toast titles/descriptions expanding beyond reasonable bounds rather than wrapping or clamping. No comments were available and the screenshot was not replayed.

varveAssessment.assessment: Potential UI layout regression lead; Varve toast sizing was not inspected or visually reproduced.

title: Eraser & other features don't work on iPadOS with margin: auto set
reason: The final reply confirms #9989 fixed an edge-swipe guard that compared pageX against container width without accounting for the editor's page offset. This explains the broad touch failures for centered/inset integrations; comments also include a friendly greeting.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve owns its editor container layout and did not reproduce this host-integrator margin:auto configuration on iPadOS.

title: Bound arrow anchor jitters while drag-resizing a selection past its bounds
reason: The reply confirms #10197 caches initial bindings from the initial shape during resize, preventing transient anchor flips while crossing the opposite selection edge.

varveAssessment.assessment: No analogous Varve bound-arrow resize jitter was reproduced or inspected.

title: [Example Request]: How to have 12 different fixed stroke sizes, or a stroke size slider
reason: Requests an SDK example for expanding the default pen-size choices or exposing a stroke-size slider. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve already has its own stroke controls; a broader range or slider requires product/UX review rather than copying an SDK example request.

title: Undo may restore a shape with a deleted parent during multiplayer
reason: Describes a concurrency case where undo restores a child whose parent frame another collaborator deleted. It depends on multiplayer conflict reconciliation; no discussion was available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve's collab presence is a stub and no multi-client undo reconciliation path exists to test this report.

title: Feature request: Disable Apple Pencil (or Stylus in general) pressure sensitivity in tldraw Obsidian plugin and tldraw itself
reason: Requests a setting to ignore stylus pressure for users who want uniform-width handwriting, both in an Obsidian plugin and upstream editor. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Potential drawing preference, but Varve's pen pressure model/settings and user demand were not inspected here.

title: Keyboard shortcuts menu item has an unnecessary ellipsis
reason: Requests removing an ellipsis from the upstream keyboard-shortcuts menu label and translations. The exact SDK translation strings are named; no comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: A small copy consistency request for upstream SDK UI; no Varve label was compared.
